title: [639592][ALAppExtensions #30277][Event Request] Codeunit 426 "Payment Tolerance Management" OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions
summary: Codeunit 426 Payment Tolerance Management now exposes a new by-reference variant of the OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions event in the NL layer, allowing subscribers to modify general journal lines before payment tolerance processing continues.
key_points: Adds OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions event with by-reference parameter for general journal lines
Subscribers can now change journal line data before sales or purchase path processing
Existing by-value event variant remains unchanged, avoiding breaking changes
Event only available in NL layer builds
No test required as this adds an extension point only
